_about: Every gate number of the strategy pipeline (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-strategy-pipeline-design.md; `bp.py pipe`), read by blueprint/pipe_rules.py: need(*keys). Shares and odds are fractions. `card` = what a pipeline card may hold (ways, values a way, indicators, bar sizes, markets, sessions: the evening session too, since 2026-10-09). `raw` = the raw heat map of stage 1: `strict` is the law's own bar (lines 2.1, 2.2, 2.4), `low` the wider door (a smaller share and half the floor, held to more trades); `floor_part` = the part of line 2.2's cost floor the average trade must reach. `indicator` = stage 3 (`other_markets` = the share of the other markets that must agree). `proof` = stage 4: `reshuffle` is line 2.8's share of the runs; `random_alpha` makes the random bar, 1 - alpha / tries, the law's ladder of line 2.3 carried on past round 5. `box` = the best days taken out at the lock and on the test (lines 3.8, 4.6), and two numbers of the book card: `fast_seconds` (a trade held that long or less is a fast trade: its share of the profit is on the card) and `month_days` (the session days of a month: winning days a month). `prop` = the 30-day prop odds of one strategy on `account`, and `book_accounts`: the rule files of the app's prop simulator whose odds a book card shows. The prop block is read in mode "law" only: mode "edge" (the shipped default since 2026-10-18) reads no prop odds. `test` = stage 6, the read of the unseen days: `one_read_a_slot` false = every pipeline idea gets its own read of the unseen days (the owner, 2026-10-08); true = the toolkit's rule: one read a family, market and session (an idea run by hand through `bp.py test` is always held to that rule; an idea's own read is one read either way). A number the law also carries (raw.strict.share = 2.1, raw.strict.trades = 2.4, proof.reshuffle = 2.8, the random bar = 2.3 to 3 decimals, box.best_days_share = 3.8 and 4.6) must be the same here and in rules.json: pipe_rules.py refuses to load when they differ. A change here is a change of the pipeline's rules: it needs the owner's word. Locked by tests/test_pipe_rules.py. `mode` = "variant" (shipped 2026-10-08, the owner: the map gets a LOOSE check and one box is picked right after it; the hard rules are judged on THAT ONE box) or "map" (the old behaviour: the whole 144-box map is judged by `raw`, `indicator` and `proof`). `variant` = the numbers of variant mode: `map_share` (stage 1: over this share of the boxes must make money), `region_boxes` and `region_trades` (at least this many boxes must be at the floor with at least this many trades; the pick is made among them; the picked box must also have that many trades), `floor_part` (the part of line 2.2's cost floor the picked box's average trade must reach), `pick_boxes` (the owner, 2026-10-09: the pick is made among the boxes at the floor that hold EVERY line a box is held to on the build days -- stage 3's rows and the lock's lines 3.3-3.8 -- and at least this many must; of them the middle one by average trade is picked (by the odds to pass the eval until 2026-10-18), never the best; the map with the most such boxes moves on), `box_tries` (the owner, 2026-10-09: "i want to make it so we dont have to worry about missing a strategy under our nose" -- when the picked box does not hold at the proof (stage 4) or cannot be locked (stage 5: worse fills), the NEXT box that holds every line is tried, from the middle outward by average trade and then the other maps' boxes, at most this many boxes an idea: the blueprint's 5 rounds; every box tried is one more try of the random bar, 1 - alpha / tries). Locked by tests/test_pipe_rules.py. `gates` (2026-10-10, the owner) = which lines ASK: see gates._about. `prop.eval` = the bar of the label "stands alone" in mode "law"; `prop.fees` = the eval fee in dollars an account costs (the owner, 2026-09-30), read by mode "law"'s fee line. `edge` = the numbers of mode "edge": see edge._about.

gates._about: THE GATES. mode "law" = every line of the blueprint asks (the pipeline as it was 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-10); mode "edge" (the owner, 2026-10-18: "keep it to just overall metrics of the strategy ... then from there we can work on how we modify the risk or strategy to trade an eval or funded") = ONE pipeline judged at one contract after costs, no prop simulator. THREE STOPS: (1) the picked box makes money after costs with `variant.region_trades` trades (rows P3.2, P3.3) and its own net is above $0 on the unseen days; (2) its win rate is at or above the breakeven win rate of its REALIZED reward-to-risk (average win / average loss, after costs) plus `edge.wr_cushion` (row P3.15), on the build days and again on the unseen days; (3) the locked map beats 95 % of the random tables on the unseen days (line 4.4). Every other line is READ and printed as a LABEL. A pass is tagged `live`, or `live+prop` when its unseen days also have a Sharpe of `edge.prop.sharpe` or more and `edge.prop.months_positive` of their months above $0. `variant` = the numbers laid over the file's own `variant` block (a floor of $0, one box at the floor is enough). The `prop` block is read by mode "law" only (its P5.9 label). A change here needs the owner's word. Locked by tests/test_pipe_rules.py and tests/test_pipe_edge_gates.py.

edge._about: the edge mode's numbers (the owner, 2026-10-18): +3 points over the breakeven win rate of the realized reward-to-risk; the Live + Prop tag asks a daily Sharpe (mean / spread of the session days' net, $0 days counted, x sqrt 252) and the share of months above $0, both on the unseen days. The Sharpe bar 1.0 is Claude's call.

winlane._about: THE WIN-RATE LANE (the owner, 2026-10-12: "most important is the win rate ... a really monthly consistent winrate"). mode "off" = nothing changes; "label" = rows P3.11 and P3.12 are READ and printed on every box as labels, asking nothing; "ask" (shipped 2026-10-12, for the cards in `cards` only) = the same two rows ask, and a box that misses either cannot be the picked box (the pick is the middle, by eval odds, of the boxes that hold them: never the best). `cards` = the card names the lane is on (a heat map of card C is named C_a5 ...); every other card is judged exactly as before; empty = every card. On the lane's cards the eval odds of gates.mode "prop" are SHOWN, not asked (the win rate comes first). P3.11: the box's win rate (trades with a net above $0 after costs, over all its trades) is `win_rate` or more. P3.12: of the months with `month_trades` trades or more, `months` of them have a win rate of `month_floor` or more. A change of a number, the mode or the cards is a change of the pipeline's rules: it needs the owner's word. Locked by tests/test_pipe_winlane.py.
